summary: SVT is 10 days old: 21 clicks, about 1,840 impressions. DASP ranks 50 to 90 for three reasons: (1) 175 DASP impressions are the crypto "Digital Asset Service Provider" licence, which SVT can never win; (2) the real query "tax on departing australia superannuation payment" (147 impr) is tested on a thin /superannuation page whose title and H1 lack the phrase and the tax table, against ATO, legislation and super fund pages; (3) the DASP topic is split across 9 URLs per language with two duplicate pairs. Of the four services, TFN has no service page (demand spread across about 14 posts), ABN has only an Uber Eats page, the tax return home page has no answer-first text, and unpaid super is split over two pages. Fix: one hub per service in en, zh and vi (/tfn new, /abn-delivery broadened, home answer block, /superannuation rebuilt), 301 the duplicates, and link every spoke to its hub. The findings include native titles, H1s and openings, plus keyword maps per language.

findings.locator: GSC Queries: "dasp licensing" 100 impr pos 51.62; "dasp licence" 55 impr pos 56.87; "dasp license" 20 impr pos 65.1
findings.problem: Over half of the DASP impressions (175 of about 330) are not about super. "DASP licence/licensing" is the crypto Digital Asset Service Provider licence (search results: legalbison.com/dasp-license, bakermckenzie.com digital asset licensing, cointelegraph). SVT appears for them only because of the acronym, at position 50 to 65, and can never convert them. Counting them makes the DASP cluster look weaker than it is.
findings.fix: Do not create or tune content for "dasp licence/licensing/license". Exclude these three queries when reporting DASP rankings (use a GSC regex filter such as ^(?!.*licen[cs]).*dasp). Use "departing Australia superannuation payment" in full in the DASP hub title, H1 and first sentence so Google reads the super meaning (see strat-02).
findings.evidence: GSC export 26 Oct to 5 Nov 2026; WebSearch "dasp licensing australia" returns crypto licensing pages (legalbison.com/dasp-license, marsh.com digital assets licensing) next to ato.gov.au/dasp.

findings.locator: meta.title 'Claim your super when you leave Australia (DASP)'; h1 'Getting your ' 'super back' ' after you leave'; tax section: 'Your fund takes tax out before paying you. If you have never held a working holiday visa, the usual rates are 35% on most super (the taxed element) and 45% on any untaxed element.'
findings.problem: The super service page is the URL Google tests for the largest real DASP query, "tax on departing australia superannuation payment" (147 impr, pos 91.28; page 160 impr, pos 90.48), and it ranks almost last. Reasons: (a) the full phrase "departing Australia superannuation payment" is not in the title or H1 and appears once in the lead; (b) the page is thin (4 short sections, about 250 words, no rate table, no steps, no documents, no timing) while the SERP is ato.gov.au, legislation.gov.au, canstar.com.au and fund pages (Aware, AustralianSuper, Australian Retirement Trust, Rest, HESTA) with full how-to content; (c) the deeper answers sit in 8 blog posts that compete with the hub (strat-03); (d) the domain is 10 days old, so the hub needs to be the single strongest page. The tax section also omits the 0% tax-free component that the blog posts give.
findings.fix: Make /superannuation the DASP hub in all 3 languages. EN: title "Departing Australia superannuation payment (DASP): tax and how to claim"; H1 "Claim your super after you leave Australia (DASP)"; answer-first opening: "A departing Australia superannuation payment (DASP) is how you get your Australian super paid out after you leave. You can apply once you have left Australia and your visa has ended. If you never held a working holiday visa, your fund usually takes 35% tax from most of it (the taxed element), 45% from any untaxed element and nothing from any tax-free component. The ATO says a complete claim is generally paid within 28 days." H2s: "Who can claim a DASP"; "DASP tax rates" (table: tax-free component 0%, taxed element 35%, untaxed element 45%, whole payment 65% if it includes super from a 417 or 462 visa period); "How to apply online, free with the ATO"; "Documents you need"; "How long it takes"; "If you wait more than 6 months"; "Moving to a 485 visa"; "Claiming with us". ZH: title "离境退超（DASP）：留学生扣多少税、怎么申领"; H1 "离开澳洲后领取养老金（DASP）"; opening "DASP（departing Australia superannuation payment，离境退超）就是离开澳洲后把养老金（super）领出来。你要先离开澳洲，而且签证已经结束，才能提交申请。如果你从没持有过打工度假签证，基金通常会对大部分养老金（taxed element）扣 35% 的税，未税部分（untaxed element）扣 45%，免税部分不扣税。ATO 表示，材料齐全的申请一般在 28 天内付款。" H2s: "谁可以申领 DASP"; "DASP 税率"; "在 ATO 网上免费申请"; "需要准备的材料"; "多久能到账"; "超过 6 个月不申领会怎样"; "转 485 签证还能领吗"; "由我们帮你申领". VI: title "Rút tiền super khi rời Úc (DASP): thuế bao nhiêu, nộp thế nào"; H1 "Rút tiền super sau khi rời Úc (DASP)"; opening "DASP (departing Australia superannuation payment) là cách rút tiền super ở Úc sau khi bạn đã rời đi. Bạn chỉ nộp được khi đã rời Úc và visa đã hết hiệu lực. Nếu bạn chưa từng có visa working holiday, quỹ thường trừ 35% thuế với phần lớn tiền super (taxed element), 45% với phần chưa chịu thuế (untaxed element) và 0% với phần miễn thuế. ATO cho biết hồ sơ đầy đủ thường được trả trong vòng 28 ngày." H2s: "Ai được rút DASP"; "Thuế suất DASP"; "Nộp trực tuyến miễn phí với ATO"; "Giấy tờ cần có"; "Bao lâu thì nhận được tiền"; "Nếu chờ quá 6 tháng"; "Chuyển sang visa 485 thì sao"; "Rút qua chúng tôi". Add the existing FAQ plus "How much tax is taken from my super when I leave?" so the tax query has a direct Q and A.
findings.evidence: GSC export 26 Oct to 5 Nov 2026 Pages: /superannuation 160 impr pos 90.48; Queries: "tax on departing australia superannuation payment" 147 pos 91.28, "departing australia superannuation payment" 8 pos 76, "superannuation leaving australia" 1 pos 78. findings.problem: Vietnamese searchers write "hoàn thuế" for both the income tax refund and the airport GST refund (TRS): "hoàn thuế ở úc" pos 41, "hoàn thuế úc" pos 38.5, "hoàn thuế ở úc được bao nhiêu" pos 35, "hướng dẫn hoàn thuế xuất cảnh úc" pos 48, "tourist refund scheme là gì" pos 10. The vi tax refund article does not use the words people type ("hoàn thuế"), and Vietnam is the second country by clicks (4 clicks, 112 impr). Competitors (accgroup.vn "Thủ tục hoàn thuế ở Úc", aztax.com.vn, ozlinks.au "khai thuế cho sinh viên quốc tế") use "hoàn thuế" and "khai thuế" in the H1.
findings.fix: VI title "Hoàn thuế ở Úc cho du học sinh: khi nào, bao lâu, cần gì"; H1 "Hoàn thuế thu nhập ở Úc cho du học sinh"; opening "Hoàn thuế thu nhập là số thuế bị trừ từ lương nhiều hơn mức bạn thực sự phải đóng, được ATO trả lại sau khi bạn khai thuế sau ngày 30 tháng 6. Số tiền khác nhau với mỗi người, và có người còn phải đóng thêm. Nếu bạn muốn lấy lại GST khi mua hàng ở sân bay, đó là chương trình Tourist Refund Scheme (TRS), xem bài riêng." Link to vi TRS article and back. Do not give a refund amount for "được bao nhiêu"; explain what changes it.
findings.evidence: GSC export 26 Oct to 5 Nov 2026 Queries and Countries sheet. WebSearch "du học sinh hoàn thuế úc".

findings.locator: GSC Queries: "417 visa super claim" 13 impr pos 51.92; "super tax working holiday maker" 4 impr pos 64.75; "gst return airport", "j1 tax back", "visitor tax refund australia"
findings.problem: Some impressions come from working holiday maker and tourist queries. Chasing working holiday queries on SVT would breach brand separation and dilute the student focus.
findings.fix: Do not create working holiday or tourist targeted pages, titles or FAQs on SVT. Keep the single factual 65% note in the DASP tax table (needed for students who also held a 417 or 462 visa) and nothing more.

findings.locator: GSC Pages row 'http://studentvisatax.com.au/' 3 clicks 3 impr pos 1.33; brand-public siteUrl 'https://studentvisatax.com.au'
findings.problem: The http home URL is reported as its own page with the brand clicks, so Google has indexed or served the http version for brand queries. Live check from this environment was blocked by the proxy (403), so the redirect could not be confirmed.
findings.fix: Confirm http:// and www. both 308/301 to https://studentvisatax.com.au/ in one hop, and that the home canonical is the absolute https URL. Use a Domain property in Search Console so http, https and www are reported together, then request indexing of the https home in URL Inspection.
